name: Welsh Government — Neurodivergence Improvement Programme priorities 2026–27
description: Welsh Government statement on current neurodivergence service-improvement priorities, including child assessment waiting times, national pathway-consistency work and development of adult ADHD options.
intended_use: Understand the current national Wales service-development context without treating a programme statement as an individual referral pathway.
audience_or_context: People in Wales, families, supporters and professionals tracking current neurodevelopmental assessment-system development.
limitations: The statement describes national programme priorities rather than the referral rules of a particular health board.
Adult ADHD options are under development and should not be represented as a completed uniform Wales pathway.
Operational child and adult pathways remain health-board dependent.
conflicts_of_interest: The Welsh Government describes a programme it funds and oversees; ND Oracle records the official policy state without assuming delivery success.

provenance.method: Welsh Government 2026–27 programme statement checked on 2026-09-03 for child waiting-time work, pathway-consistency work and adult ADHD task-and-finish activity. Listing is descriptive and claimless.
